reasons: Rule kind is 'missing' and the document contains no insurance obligation anywhere (search for 'insurance' returns nothing; miscellaneous Sections 13-30 are silent), so the 'missing' classification is correct and actionable.

The inserted Section 31 tracks the playbook model language at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O incl. tech E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request) and correctly uses the resolved counterparty name 'TrueLink' and 'Client'; placement after Force Majeure (p0097) in the miscellaneous section matches the redline guidance.
No existing text is altered, so there is no over-editing risk; deterministic checks (operation applies, insurance obligation present) both pass.

Comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, prefixed, states what changed and why (hosting of Client Content/customer credit data), and offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) as the rule directs.

Minor, non-blocking: the survival cross-reference in p0090 ('Sections 1 and 5 through 30') is not conformed to include the new Section 31, but the finding flags this as an administrative fix rather than misstating it.
